decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Plan 2, received 9 February 2012; and drawing notated P/2012/1268, received 5 September 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall commence until 1:100 and 1:20 scaled drawings showing the position, style and finish of the gate and railings hereby approved, have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. The gate and railings shall only be installed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall commence until details of the retention of existing landscaping and provision of any replacement planting adjacent to the railing fence has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The landscaping details approved shall be implemented prior to the first use of the gate and maintainer in accordance with the approved details thereafter.

Condition : 5 - No development shall commence until details of the automatic operation of the gate and its control have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The gate shall be operated in accordance with the approved details thereafter.
description: Installation of pedestrian gate and railings on existing private pathway.
